subject: HELLENIC AIRFORCE WILL MAKE A WITHOUT FIRING EXERCISE WITHIN

ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR AS DESCRIBED BELOW:
1.- EXERCISE AREA (WITHOUT FIRING): 372726N 0213914E - 361000N
0210500E - 370000N 0191530E - 373021N 0191422E - 380701N 0194452E -
380126N 0203106E - 375700N 0212000E - 373700N 0214405E - 373726N
0213914E.
AWYS M/UM601 (LASKO-KFN), M/UM601 (KFN-TRL), M/UM872 (KFN-ETILI),
Y/UY302 (OSDES-ZAK), A/UA145 (LORNO-ANEPI), M/UM729 (LORNO-TITUS),
L/UL81 (TETUZ-LORNO), M/UM728 (BELIX-RERSA), ZAKINTHOS/ DIONISIOS
SOLOMOS CTR/ATZ, ANDRAVIDA MTMA, LGD61, LGD72A2, LGD72B2, LGD72D,
LGD73, LGD93, LGD94 AFFECTED.
2.- PROCEDURES FOR EXERCISE AIRCRAFT:
2.1.- EXERCISE AIRCRAFT WILL FLY VFR/VMC IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO
RULES AND PROCEDURES AS AMPLIFIED IN AIP-GREECE.
2.2.- EXERCISE AIRCRAFT WILL SUBMIT FLIGHT PLANS AND WILL NOT ENTER
CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, UNLESS PRIOR PERMISSION HAS BEEN OBTAINED BY
APPROPRIATE ATC UNITS.
3.- PROCEDURES FOR NON EXERCISE AIRCRAFT:
3.1.- IN THE INTEREST OF SAFETY DURING THE EXERCISE, NON EXERCISE
AIRCRAFT ARE STRONGLY ADVISED NOT TO FLY WITHIN THE AREA
DESIGNATED IN PARA (1) ABOVE.
3.2.- AIRCRAFT UNABLE TO AVOID THE EXERCISE AREA WILL BE AUTHORIZED END PART 1 OF 2
